primer: AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) has navigated the Humira patent cliff cleanly, with Skyrizi ($21.8B FY26E) and Rinvoq ($10.3B FY26E) driving ~$67.8B in FY2026E revenue. However, Q3 2026 gross debt sits at $80.90B with -$4.58B stockholders' equity and $27.31B in contingent consideration liabilities. At $286.20, our 10-year DCF ($21.50B FCF, 8.5% WACC, 2.5% g, deducting $81.25B net debt and Skyrizi claims) yields $315.00 Base, $235.00 Bear, $365.00 Bull, and $305.00 Expected Value. Even at $278.20 support vs. a $252.23 stop, Base R:R (1.42:1) and EV R:R (1.03:1) fail our 1.50:1 gate in a 10-dist-day Downtrend, so we assign REJECTED (TIER_0, VALUATION) with 100% cash.
